title: Baker Victory Services training to quantum unentangle

tellings.quote: at Baker Victory Services, a lot of their work was having you quantum unentangle with things that you were entangled with.

plain: Michels says that at a place called Baker Victory Services, much of the work was teaching people to "quantum unentangle" from things they were entangled with, borrowing a physics term for linked particles to describe cutting some kind of hidden connection. He says it himself, without naming a source, in an interview with a guest who says he was taken into a UFO programme as a child, and the telling gives no more detail about what that training involved.
